overview.text: The Blackneck Garter Snake is a harmless garter snake of the south-western United States, Mexico and Guatemala, usually found near water.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: South-western USA (southern Colorado and Utah to Arizona, New Mexico and Texas), much of Mexico, and Guatemala.

habitat.text: Near water in desert scrub, grassland, chaparral and woodland.

behaviour.text: Active by day and at dusk, sometimes at night. It hibernates from late autumn through winter and mates in late spring or summer.

diet.text: Hunts in rivers and streams for small fish, amphibians, other snakes and earthworms.

recognise.text: Garter snake usually seen near water in dry country.
